newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse to trade two newcomers.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse to trade two newcomers.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse said on Monday the number of its listings would rise to 56 on Wednesday as two more companies joined in trading on the second tier.
The newcomers are Morarit-Panificatie SA milling and baking company, based in the eastern city of Galati, and the Peco Arad SA petrol retailer located in Arad, in the Transylvanian region.
* Number of shares: 15,331,150; each share has a face value of 1,000 lei.
* Ownership structure: The State Ownership Fund (FPS) has a 19.97 percent, other investors 59.94, employees 20. Managers hold the rest.
* Net profit in first half of 1997: 6.346 billion lei; in 1996: 1.657 billion lei; in 1995: 1.972 billion lei;
* Dividend per share: in 1996: 28.50 lei; in 1995: 364 lei.
* Number of shares: 7,284,550; each share has a face value of 1,000 lei.
* Ownership structure: The FPS holds 50.88 percent and other stockholders have 49.12 percent.
* Net profit in the first half of 1997: 1.816 billion lei; in 1996: 3.032 billion lei; in 1995: 1.343 billion lei; .
* Dividend per share in 1996: 4,040 lei; in 1995 1,759 lei.
The Bucharest stock exchange trades 45 firms on the second tier and nine companies on the first tier.
